options.label: Are you on Consecrated Ground?
options.tooltip: Explicit standing-on-ground snapshot for this actor only: regenerate 5% of maximum Life per second and take 50% reduced Curse effect. Does not assume ground ownership or uptime from an equipped source. Modifiers to ground you create are not included.
